parsed.answer: Immediately after the August 8 meeting, Ivo’s Cobalt project was still approved for batch delivery using BATCH-1-741. At that meeting the team tested REPLAY-1-632, but no delivery-mode change was approved; Cobalt was not switched to STREAM until August 15.

citations.quote: They chose BATCH-1-741 for batch delivery.
No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
2026-08-15. Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286.
